descripcion: Fatty alcohol widely used as a co-emulsifier and consistency agent in cosmetic emulsions. It provides body, stability, and a soft emollient feel to creams, lotions, and hair conditioners.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pearls, or pastilles depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Blend of cetyl and stearyl fatty alcohols used as a consistency base in all types of emulsions. It stabilizes the oil phase and improves the sensory feel of creams and hair care products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or pearls depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic fatty acid of the cosmetics industry, used to give body and opacity to emulsions and as a saponifiable base in shaving creams and creamy soaps. Its partial neutralization produces stable emulsified systems.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, flakes, or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ester of glycerin and stearic acid used as a primary emulsifier and consistency agent in oil-in-water emulsions. It provides stability, creaminess, and a non-greasy finish highly valued in skin care products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, flakes, or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic emulsifier derived from sugars and fatty alcohols, in high demand for natural-trend formulations. It produces stable emulsions with a light feel and is compatible with a wide range of cosmetic actives.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, flakes, or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Light, fast-spreading emollient ester used to reduce the greasy feel of emulsions and improve the glide of body oils and makeup removers. It also acts as a carrier for fragrances and oil-soluble actives.
formas_referenciales: Low-viscosity oily liquid

descripcion: Plant-derived emollient with excellent oxidative stability, valued for its dry, silky feel. It serves as a base oil phase, a carrier for oil-soluble actives, and a support for extracts and fragrances.
formas_referenciales: Light oily liquid

descripcion: Coconut-derived amphoteric surfactant, a cornerstone of mild cleansing formulas. It boosts and stabilizes foam, reduces the irritation potential of anionic surfactants, and adds viscosity to shampoos and liquid soaps.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, variable viscosity depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant from the alkyl polyglucoside family, derived from sugars and plant-based fatty alcohols. Its mildness profile makes it ideal for sensitive-skin cleansers, baby products, and natural-trend formulas.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — aqueous solution, variable shade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mild anionic surfactant derived from coconut fatty acids, known for its creamy foam and excellent skin compatibility. It is the preferred base for syndet bars, solid shampoos, and cleansers with low irritation potential.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, granules, or needles depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Benchmark humectant in the cosmetics industry and one of the most versatile raw materials on the market. It attracts and retains water in formulations, improves spreadability, and works as a solvent for actives; in foods, its use is governed by the applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid

descripcion: Fermentation-derived glycol positioned as a clean-label alternative to propylene glycol. It acts as a humectant and as a solvent for actives and preservatives, with a less tacky feel than glycerin.
formas_referenciales: Colorless low-viscosity liquid

descripcion: Vitamin B5 derivative used in skin and hair care formulations, associated with humectant and conditioning properties. It is a classic active in hair care products, hand creams, and formulas for skin in need of comfort.
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid
Solid — powder depending on the commercial variant and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of hyaluronic acid, a biopolymer with high water-retention capacity obtained by fermentation. It is one of the most sought-after humectant actives on the market, used in formulations associated with hydration and a smooth skin appearance; it is sold in different molecular weight ranges.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or fine granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amino acid-derived humectant that is part of the skin's natural moisturizing factor. It is incorporated into formulations to improve water retention in skin and hair, with a mild profile and good compatibility with other ingredients.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly amber aqueous solution depending on the batch

descripcion: Amide form of vitamin B3 and one of the most widely used multifunctional actives in facial care today. It is used in formulations associated with tone evenness, pore appearance, and skin barrier comfort, with excellent stability and ease of formulation.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydroquinone glucoside obtained enzymatically, used in cosmetic formulations associated with an even-looking skin tone. It is a high-demand active in facial care serums and creams thanks to its stability and compatibility with other cosmetic depigmenting ingredients.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, white to cream shade depending on the batch

descripcion: Alkaloid widely used as a cosmetic active in eye contour, body care, and hair care formulations, associated with a revitalized skin appearance. In beverages and supplements, its use is governed by the applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Main component of chamomile oil, used in formulations for sensitive skin and associated with a feeling of comfort and calm. It is available in natural and synthetic versions, both with a long track record in the cosmetics market.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid, colorless to slightly yellowish depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Lipid identical to those found in the skin's stratum corneum, used in formulations associated with skin barrier care. It is a high-value active in cosmetic repair creams, products for dry skin, and dermocosmetic lines.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or waxy flakes depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic active with a long track record, used in formulations associated with skin comfort and softness. Its versatility and low in-use cost make it a staple in creams, hair care products, toothpastes, and after-sun formulas.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dicarboxylic acid used as an active in cosmetic formulations for blemish-prone skin and uneven tone. Its versatility positions it in serums, creams, and gels for specialized facial care.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Short-chain alpha hydroxy acid and a benchmark in cosmetic chemical exfoliation. It is used in formulations associated with renewing the skin's appearance and a more even texture, at concentrations and pH levels in accordance with the applicable cosmetic regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution
Solid — crystals or powder depending on the commercial variant and batch

descripcion: Oil-soluble beta hydroxy acid used in cosmetic formulations for oily and blemish-prone skin, associated with exfoliation of the skin's surface and inside the pore. It is also used as a preservation adjuvant at doses in accordance with cosmetic regulations.
aplicaciones: Cleansers and toners for oily skin
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine crystalline powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Broad-spectrum preservative in global use, a benchmark for the antimicrobial protection of cosmetic formulas within the limits of the applicable regulations. It is compatible with most systems and is frequently combined with ethylhexylglycerin or other boosters.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, slightly viscous liquid

descripcion: Benchmark oil-soluble antioxidant, used both to protect oil phases from oxidation and as an active associated with skin care. Available in natural and synthetic variants; in foods and supplements, its use is governed by the applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily liquid — variable amber shade depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Organic UV filter used in sunscreens and daily care products with sun protection, within the limits of the applicable cosmetic regulations. It stands out for its photostability and for helping stabilize other filters in the formula, such as avobenzone.
aplicaciones: Hair care products with UV protection
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily liquid — variable yellowish shade depending on the batch

descripcion: Widely used organic filter for protection against UVA radiation, employed in sunscreens in accordance with the applicable cosmetic regulations. It is typically formulated alongside stabilizers such as octocrylene to maintain its photochemical performance.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, white to yellowish shade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Long-chain cationic surfactant, a benchmark in deep hair conditioning. It eases detangling, adds softness, and reduces frizz in conditioners, masks, and treatments, with a mildness profile superior to that of short-chain quats.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, pastilles, or flakes depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic quaternary ammonium compound for hair conditioning, used in rinses, styling creams, and treatments. It provides detangling and static control, and also serves as a cationic emulsifier in conditioning systems.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous or hydroalcoholic solution depending on the commercial variant and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble cationic polymer used as a conditioner in rinse-off systems. It improves the feeling of softness on skin and hair during and after washing, and is a common additive in shampoos, shower gels, and liquid soaps.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — colorless to slightly hazy aqueous solution depending on the batch

descripcion: Cationic derivative of guar gum used as a deposition conditioner in cleansing systems. It improves wet combability, softens the skin in shower gels, and contributes to the viscosity of the formula.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, white to yellowish shade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cross-linked acrylic polymer, the global standard for thickening and stabilizing gels and emulsions. Once neutralized, it produces transparent gels with a characteristic rheology, and it suspends particles and actives with great efficiency at low use levels.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine fluffy powder, grade and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Benchmark silicone in personal care, available in multiple nominal viscosities. It provides a silky sensory feel, shine, and surface protection in hair and skin products, and also reduces the tackiness of emulsions.
formas_referenciales: Silicone fluid — variable viscosity depending on the grade and batch

descripcion: Dry-feel emollient with high affinity for the skin's lipids, currently obtained from plant sources such as sugarcane or olives. It is one of the most in-demand natural alternatives to silicones, with excellent stability and a light sensory feel.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, odorless oily liquid

descripcion: Universal chelating agent that sequesters metal ions present in water and raw materials. It protects the color, scent, and stability of formulas, and improves the performance of preservative and foaming systems.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch
